review_notes:
I read the whole target file and checked its new definitions: realLineHeat, realLineHeatOperator, realHeatList, realCylinderHeat, viscousCylinderHeat, laplacianEvaluation, heatFlow, and the EulerStrongOperatorDerivative lemmas. All of them extend or specialise the library's own heat semigroup objects (lineHeat, heatList, cylinderHeat, heatOperator, jetLaplacian). Mathlib has no matching concept for the Sobolev-space or cylinder heat flow.

The one competing Mathlib concept I found is gaussianMeasure, which is defined in GaussianKernels.lean and not in this file. It is rfl-equal to ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal. This file only uses it, and it does so alongside Mathlib lemmas such as gaussianReal_map_const_mul. Because the declaration lives in another file, I did not report it against this one. A review of GaussianKernels.lean could raise it.

The product-rule lemmas hasDerivAt_apply and hasDerivWithinAt_apply are theorems with different hypotheses from Mathlib's HasDerivAt.clm_apply. They need only strong joint continuity, not operator-norm differentiability. The rubric excludes standalone theorem duplication, so I did not report them.

The wrappers realLineHeat and realCylinderHeat (the toNNReal extensions) are intentional named specialisations. I found no Mathlib counterpart that would make them redundant.
